targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: five launch-video transcript readers, moved byte for byte

preserve: a video's manual en json3 track wins over every other en track; else the first by name
an event without segs or with blank text is skipped; a new paragraph starts 30 seconds or more after the last began
each transcript is '# title', the watch link, the channel, the captions line, a blank line, then '[m:ss] paragraph' lines
the index has one row per listed video with its title, upload date, views, duration, likes, whether it has text, the channel and the caption file
allowed_deltas: the channel's label and its source-channel name are arguments
the last line is {"result": {rows, with_captions, index}}
banned_substitutions: a channel name written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
